title: PyNMDF: Python for Network Minimum Demand Forecasting
description: PyNMDF is the reproducible analysis code behind research on forecasting minimum demand in distribution networks as rooftop photovoltaic (PV) capacity grows. It holds one shared package and one folder per publication. Every input is public.
